description: ProgressAnimator runs at `fps` frames per second. Each frame applies its events with now = frame / fps, steps by 1 / fps, then records the state when frame is a multiple of `every`. A value of "NaN" stands for NaN.

scenarios.description: Isolated updates glide forward in 0.5 s and backward in 0.4 s
Rhythmic updates every 0.1 s keep moving without stopping
Rhythmic updates that slow down, with a jump back
Indeterminate, then determinate from 0, then indeterminate again at speed 1.5
Reduce motion jumps to the value, stops ambient time and halves the indeterminate speed
The buffer glides on its own
Values outside 0 to 1 are clamped and the wave flattens near the ends
Long frames of 0.1 s keep the wave spring settled
